key_points: NVIDIA researchers propose five guidelines for optimizing speculative decoding in AI model co-design.
The authors report that speculative decoding accelerates inference by predicting multiple tokens per iteration using a draft model.
Guideline one suggests increasing draft length to push GEMMs into a compute-bound region without increasing KV cache capacity pressure.
Guideline two recommends choosing a draft length equal to 128 divided by the number of query heads per KV head minus one when attention dominates.
The authors advise benchmarking acceptance length and draft overhead under realistic serving conditions to select the optimal draft mechanism.
items.summary: NVIDIA researchers present a guide for accelerating large language model inference through speculative decoding while maintaining accuracy. The authors report that this technique predicts multiple tokens per iteration using a small draft model to verify outputs in parallel with a larger target model. They provide five specific guidelines for selecting draft length and mechanism across the Pareto frontier. First, increase draft length to push GEMMs into a compute-bound region without increasing KV cache pressure. Second, when attention dominates decode time, choose a draft length calculated as 128 divided by the number of query heads per KV head minus one. Third, prefer draft lengths where the product of query heads and draft length plus one is a multiple of 128 to avoid tile underutilization. Fourth, at very low latency, increase draft length only while the gain in acceptance length justifies the added draft cost. Finally, choose the draft mechanism by balancing acceptance length and draft overhead for the specific workload and hardware. The authors recommend using SPEED-Bench for acceptance measurements and NVIDIA TensorRT LLM for quantifying draft overhead.
items.title: NVIDIA outlines five guidelines for co-designing AI models using speculative decoding

items.summary: U.S. uranium production reached 2.13 million pounds in the first half of 2026, yet domestic output remains a small fraction of reactor fuel needs. items.summary: The Supreme Court set aside a ₹425 crore penalty on Gujarat diamond trader Vijay Ghanshyam Gadiya after the original order relied on non-existent case laws generated by AI. items.summary: The article explores how Uttam Kumar remains a defining figure in Bengali cinema decades after his death. Critics found the 2024 film Oti Uttam apathetic, yet it became a box-office hit that proved his magic still enchants audiences. Uttam Kumar died in 1980 at age 53, but his name remains synonymous with Bengali cinema and culture. His career began with eight flops between 1948 and 1952 before he achieved stardom with Basu Paribar in 1952. He formed an iconic pairing with Suchitra Sen, appearing together in 30 films over 22 years. Unlike many stars, Uttam played darker, flawed characters and took supporting roles for artistic reasons. Satyajit Ray cast him in Nayak, portraying a middle-class youth, and later in Chiriyakhana as Byomkesh Bakshi. Soumitra Chatterjee acknowledged Uttam's unmatched popularity, comparing their rivalry to rival football clubs. Uttam represented the honest, middle-class Bengali man and became a symbol of Bengaliness. His mass adulation is compared to that of Rudolph Valentino in Hollywood. As Satyajit Ray noted, there will never be another like Uttam Kumar.
items.title: Uttam Kumar's enduring legacy shines in Bengali cinema and culture
